whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Road House Restro & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has good 4.3★ reviews in Lodipur, Patna, but currently relies on third-party listing pages like EazyDiner rather than a dedicated brand website for direct table bookings and party inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, digital food menu, aur party booking inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/roadhouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Road House Restro & Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct table reservation, menu showcase, and local discovery near City Centre Mall in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
